upcoming.title: FROM THE ANNEX Women's Shootout 11/28 7:30am
upcoming.description: We will start in front of the Mercado Annex. They have graciously allowed us to use their bathrooms. There is no official B group this week, but we are always happy to have a B group if the B ladies are okay with not having an official ride leader. If you would like to be a B group leader, please let us know and we will officially advertise it. This ride is every week, but we individually list each ride. Regular info below. *** FAQ How fast? The "A" group averages 18-20mph. On the second Saturday only, we also have a "B" group that averages 15-17mph. No drop? This is NOT a no drop ride. However, we wait five minutes to regroup at The Bridge (Mile 15.5) and Sprint Hill (Mile 26). These are also our sprint points for "friendly competition." What can I expect? We usually ride in two lines and rotate. The rider at the front right is in the wind and doing the most work. When you’re ready to pull off, or if you can’t hold the group’s speed, move left and slide back into the left-hand line. Pulls can be long or short. How long? The full shootout route is 65 miles, but most of us ride to Sprint Hill, which is 49. The shorter turnaround points you can do are: The Bridge (32 miles total distance) and Helmet Peak Rd (42 miles). Where? We roll from in front of the MSA Annex, a couple blocks from the Mercado San Augustin. When? The time changes with the seasons/sunrise. Check our Strava event for the exact time. Parking? There is paid parking in the Mercado parking lots and free parking on side streets. Stops/refueling? Ladies doing the full route will stop at a gas station about halfway through. If you are planning to turn around earlier, plan to carry all of your nutrition and hydration. Other questions? Interested in becoming a ride leader? Email wso [dot] tucson [at] gmail

additionalShootout.title: Co-Ed Holiday Sunday Ride & Party | Women’s Shootout Tucson - Eventbrite RSVP
additionalShootout.description: Celebrate the season with a morning on the bike, followed by coffee, food, and good company at Pace Ranch! Hosted by Women’s Shootout Tucson, this co-ed event welcomes all Tucson road cyclists who are comfortable riding in a group. Please RSVP on Eventbrite to help us get a head count for coffee and food. https://www.eventbrite.com/e/co-ed-holiday-ride-party-presented-by-womens-shootout-tucson-tickets-2004863494682 📍 Pace Ranch: 12680 E. Fort Lowell Rd. 🚲 8:00am — Ride out Choose your adventure: - Mount Lemmon | 20–28 miles: The base of the mountain is about 4 miles from Pace Ranch. Climb at your own pace and choose your turnaround point so you’re back at the ranch by 10:30am. Mount Lemmon route: https://ridewithgps.com/routes/57891731 - Saguaro East | 26 miles: Enjoy a desert ride before heading back to the ranch for the festivities. Saguaro East route: https://ridewithgps.com/routes/57891597 ☕ 10:00am — Coffee, food & mingling The food will be out by 10am, ready for riders as they return. Plan to be back by 10:30am so you have plenty of time to eat and catch up! Bring your riding buddies and come spend a festive morning with us! 🎄

additionalShootout.title: Winterhaven Slow Roll 12/17 6:15pm from Hop Shop - Lights Required
additionalShootout.description: The third annual WSO Winterhaven slow roll, starting and ending at Hop Shop. You must have lights. Mountain and commuter bikes are recommended due to the pace of the ride. If you want to ride your road bike, wear sneakers. Kids and male friends/partners are welcome if joining as a guest of a woman rider, but they must also have lights. Please be sure to have adequate clothing. Festive attire encouraged. Although Winterhaven is typically crowded, this event is early enough that we don't usually have issues with crowds. (Winterhaven opens at 6pm.)

sisterClubEvents.title: Rancho Vistoso Ride
sisterClubEvents.description: TIME CHANGE roll out at 8:00am Monthly Women’s Ride We meet the last Sunday of the month unless it’s a holiday. The ride starts from the intersection of Mountain and the Rillito Path (north side by the javelina statue that was vandalized)- not actually Via Entrada. Location is pinned on the map. 4O-ish mile ride; has multiple join-on locations and is safe if someone has a flat or mechanical issue and is not out in the middle of nowhere. Intermediate and Advanced road cycling Please tell your friends and I hope to see you on Sunday. BICYCLE RIDING IS AN INHERENTLY DANGEROUS SPECIFICALLY DISCLAIM RESPONSIBILITY FOR ANY ACCIDENT OR INJURY THAT OCCURS ON OUR RIDE. EVERY PERSON IS RESPONSIBLE FOR THEIR OWN SAFETY AND THE SAFETY OF OTHERS AROUND THEM. * this is a women’s only ride.. *

sisterClubEvents.title: Mount Lemmon
sisterClubEvents.description: Meet in Madera Village near the Dental Office. Will ride together to the base of Mount Lemmon (MP0) and then we will ride at our own pace for as little or as far as you want to go up Lemmon. All ladies are welcome! Hope to see you there!
